references.text: The Lord calls Moses and Aaron to come to him, a parallel to how the Lord suddenly calls the three siblings.
The pillar of cloud descended at the entrance of the tabernacle when the Lord spoke with Moses, linking it to the tent of meeting mentioned in the verse.
The Lord commands Moses to gather the elders at the tent of meeting, a similar pattern where God calls people to the tent of meeting to speak with them.
Korah gathers the congregation against Moses and Aaron at the entrance of the tent of meeting, where the glory of the Lord is revealed.
The Lord commands Moses and Joshua to stand in the tent of meeting, a pattern where God calls servants to the tent of meeting to receive revelation.
God's dwelling place and his residence are mentioned, linking it to the tent of meeting as the place where God meets his people.
Moses' faithfulness throughout God's house is highlighted, and both Moses and Aaron served at the tent of meeting as God's chosen leaders.
